en: A black-and-white photograph postcard showing a large ceremonial procession with crowds of people, soldiers, and young women in traditional Alsatian dress. The background features historic timber-framed buildings with French flags and signs in both French and German. The scene is lively, with a central figure on horseback, likely a notable French military leader, parading through the street.
